posts.text: Day 1, 12 days out. Two things I saw: VBC covered the Kessa-North highway opening, Kito TV aired the first debate where both candidates were pressed on costings. Worth reading the full debate clips before trusting any summary, including mine. #VelorianElection

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway vs Arden promising 200k jobs with no costings. Cool, so we get two sales pitches and zero math. Can someone just tell me which one of them is going to make rent cheaper? 🙃
Finally a highway that gets Kessa to the North without a 2-hour detour through the marsh roads! Ostrand's crew delivered. Traffic's gonna be sweet now, drivers rejoice 🚕🛣️

Watched the first debate. Ostrand defended inflation with a lot of confidence, but when the moderators asked for the costings behind her highway promises, the numbers didn't really come. Arden's 200,000 jobs claim needs the same scrutiny. Neither side has earned trust yet. Show the workings.
Watched the first debate. Ostrand defended inflation, Arden put a number on jobs. Both got pressed on costings. Still waiting for someone to show the math on either side.

Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it prosperity. My fertiliser bill just doubled and fuel's up again. Ask the farmers in the north what prosperity looks like. Arden at least got asked about the costings tonight. Did she answer?

Watched the Kito debate tonight. Arden says 200,000 jobs but nobody asked where the money comes from. Ostrand's inflation answer was vague too. Hospitals are still short-staffed whoever wins. Someone tell me the actual numbers?

Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks don't break down on the way to Millbrook. Debate tonight too. Ask the hard questions on costs, both of them. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #Veloria

Saw the Unity Party page claim Arden's plan DOUBLES VAT on food. Before we share anything that big, let's see the actual plan document and the costings. Hot claims go viral fast, and a careful pot doesn't boil over. #VelorianElection

Day 2, 11 out. VeriCheck just ran Arden's VAT and fuel claims: VAT doubling is FALSE, the 40% fuel figure uses a peak month. Their estimate puts a ~2% of GDP gap in his plan. Ostrand's highway costs still need checking too. Read the checks before you repost them, mine included. #VelorianElection

Fuel up 40% and the Civic Front wants me to believe it's all Ostrand's fault? Fine, show me the fuel tax line item and the global crude chart next to it. Then tell me what Arden's costings actually are. #Veloria

Read the VeriCheck breakdown on Arden's plan. VAT doubling: false. The 40% fuel figure: a peak month, not a trend. But a roughly 2% of GDP gap is real money, and it hasn't been explained. Both camps should answer that before anyone claims the math is settled. #VelorianElection

Two weeks out and I still can't tell which candidate makes rent cheaper. Ostrand has a highway, Arden has 200k jobs, nobody has shown the math. Can we get the costings before the vote? 🙃 #VelorianElection

Two weeks of ribbon cuttings and 'jobs jobs jobs' and zero costings. Taxi tip: when both drivers keep honking and nobody moves the car, you check the engine, not the horn. Show the math, both of you. 🚕

Read VeriCheck's breakdown of Arden's plan. Doubled VAT is false, the 40% fuel figure is cherry-picked from a peak month, but there's still a ~2% of GDP hole nobody's explaining. Ostrand's side needs to answer that too.
Two weeks to the vote and I'm still waiting for one number from either side. Not a slogan. A number. How are hospitals getting more staff under either plan? Anyone?

Watched the VBC clip on the 'recording' twice. Audio quality is poor and nobody has authenticated it yet. Before we treat it as settled, let's hear from a forensic check, not just the headline. Both camps should be held to the same standard. #VelorianElection

Day 3, 10 out. VBC is airing a clip of Arden's 'recording' as 'questions raised', and the Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before anyone passes it around: who supplied the audio, has the file been checked for authenticity, and is the full clip in context? I've only heard what VBC played. Holding judgement until someone verifies it. #VelorianElection

Ok so a 'leaked' audio goes round WhatsApp, the Civic Front says it's AI, and VBC just plays the whole clip and says 'questions raised'. Who benefits from that clip being everywhere? Wait for a forensic check before forwarding anything, including this. #VelorianElection

Watched the VBC clip on the Arden recording. 'Questions raised' and 'the Civic Front says it's not genuine' is not evidence either way. Who verified the file? Where did it come from? Can we get VeriCheck on this before we treat it as fact? #VelorianElection

Day 3 and VBC just played a 'questions raised' clip of Arden with no source, no date, no chain of custody. Civic Front says it's fake. Cool, so now we're doing audio drama with 10 days left? Can a fact-checker look at this before it's all over my feed? 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 3. That 'leaked audio' is going round the group chats with the word FORWARD on it. Before I pass anything on, I want to know who recorded it, when, and whether anyone has checked it. VBC says questions are raised, not that it's proven. A careful pot doesn't boil over. Wait for the checks. #VelorianElection

Day 4, 9 out. Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. So it's a coin flip with a tiny gap. Meanwhile Patriots Daily's 'foreign passport' bombshell has zero sourcing in the post. Who's checking that one before it spreads? Holding judgement 🙃 #VelorianElection

Kito TV poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. That's inside the error bars, so nobody's winning yet. Ten percent still not sure and two weeks to go. Show me the costings from BOTH of them before I pick. #VelorianElection

Day 4. Kito poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's inside the margin, so it's a coin flip with nine days left. Still waiting for the costings from both sides before I decide. #VelorianElection

Day 4. Kito TV says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat with a gap smaller than the error bars. Doesn't tell me much except it's close. Same question as ever: show the costings, both of you. 🚕

Day 4. Kito poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a tie with a margin of error, folks. Don't let anyone tell you it's over. Still want the costings from BOTH sides before I decide. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #VelorianElection

Day 4, 9 out. Two stories today. Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port. Before sharing: which passport, sourced to what, and has VeriCheck looked at it? Kito TV's poll is Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a statistical tie, so don't read a winner into it. Check the claim before you repost it. #VelorianElection

Read the Ledger's road funds story. 'Documents suggest' and 'ministry says fabricated' is two sentences, not evidence. Who has the documents, and has anyone checked them? Before we treat it as fact, let's see the paper trail. #VelorianElection

Day 4. The Ledger's road-funds story is a serious allegation, and the ministry calling it 'fabricated' isn't an answer on its own. Before we decide, we need the documents themselves: where they came from, whether they've been authenticated, and what the ministry's specific rebuttal says. Same standard for every camp. #VelorianElection

Day 5. Someone's got a WhatsApp 'ambassador' link paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paying people to deliver votes is a red flag whichever side it helps. Don't click, don't forward. Also: the commission is publishing the results forms on VeloResults. Go look at the test, that's how we check the count. #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 out. VEC says it's publishing the results-transmission procedure: polling-station forms scanned and uploaded to the public VeloResults portal, with observer system tests. Good. Anyone can check the process itself. Worth attending a test if you can. #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 out. Two trending tags, #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs, with dozens of brand-new accounts posting near-identical text within minutes? Cool, so now the sky's a bot farm too. Anyone who wants my vote can show me actual costings, not copy-paste. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 5. Someone's offering 2,000 vel to be a 'community ambassador' and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity, via a WhatsApp bot link. Paid to recruit, paid for votes? Who runs that bot before anyone signs up? Check before you click. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 5. The Commission's VeloResults procedure is worth a read: scanned polling-station forms, public upload, observers invited to test the system. Transparency is the right instinct. Let's show up to that test and see it for ourselves, whoever's ahead. #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 out. Saw #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs both trending, and the researchers say dozens of accounts behind each tag were made this month and posted near-identical text. Before you pick a side, check who's actually behind the tags. Still waiting for costings from BOTH campaigns.

Day 5. Trending tags #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs: researchers say dozens of accounts behind each were created this month and posted near-identical text within minutes. Before you amplify either tag, check who's pushing it. The commission just published its results-transmission process too, so forms go to VeloResults and observers can test it. #VelorianElection

Day 5. A WhatsApp msg says sign up as a 'community ambassador' for Unity, 2,000 vel + 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paid to register and paid per vote? Who's on the other end of that bot link? Don't send your details to it. #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 out. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going viral; her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Fine, that's a gaffe, not a scandal. Anyone with the full clip and date, post it so we can all see the context. Same standard for every candidate. #VelorianElection
Day 6, 7 out. Ostrand mispronounces a provincial town and her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Cool, I'll accept that. Now show me the costings from both of them before I pick. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before anyone travels or tells their neighbours, check the IECV website and their official channels. A letter with a logo isn't proof. Check first, then share. #VelorianElection

Day 6. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going round. 'Slip of the tongue' from her team. Fine. Gaffes are not the economy though. Still waiting on both sides' costings. #VelorianElection

Fuel up 40%, polling stations moving 'for security' with a WhatsApp letter nobody can verify, and both camps still won't show real costings. Ostrand's team calls the viral clip 'a slip of the tongue'. Show me the numbers from BOTH sides before I trust either. Check IECV's site for the actual station list. #Veloria #VelorianElection

Day 6. The Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town is funny for a second, then it's just a slip. The question I keep asking is the same one: what does the 2% of GDP gap in Arden's plan mean for my rent? Show the costings, both sides. #VelorianElection

Day 6. Still no costings from either side. Ostrand's highway number, Arden's 200k jobs number, and now a 'polling stations moving' letter with no way to verify it. Before you share the letter, check the IECV site or call your local office. Show me the math, both of you. 🚕

Day 6, 7 out. Someone's forwarding an 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before anyone goes anywhere: check the IECV site or call the commission. A letterhead isn't proof. Also, VBC & Kito are pushing 'foreign funding' claims with no sources. Show me the documents. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. The 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note is still going round. Nobody should be told to skip voting by a forwarded note. Check the IECV site for your polling station and go vote. Costings from BOTH sides still missing. #VelorianElection

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Reminder: the 'OFFICIAL' polling-station letter is still unverified. Check IECV's site before sharing. And if you see paid 'ambassador' links, don't click. Quiet week, clear head. #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so let's use the quiet to check the claims we've been passing around. Ostrand's economic record and Arden's plan both deserve the same scrutiny: sources, costings, documents. Read them before you share. #VelorianElection

Day 7, silence starts tonight and I'm still waiting on real costings from BOTH of you. Two trending tags, dozens of brand-new accounts, and a viral clip that's just a slip of the tongue. Cool. Show me the numbers or I'm sitting this one out. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Voice note going round says 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' Don't. Vote. Don't let anyone's voice note decide your Sunday. Check the IECV site for your station. #VelorianElection

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Got a voice note forwarded 5 times telling us to stay home tomorrow because 'we have it covered'. Nah. Vote, then check the official results on VeloResults. Not the group chat. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Everyone's phone is full of 'stay home' voice notes and singer endorsements. I'd still like one costed plan from either side before polls close. Same question as always. Check the official sources before you forward anything. 🚕

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the trending Zuri K clip is the last big push. Celebrity endorsement isn't a costing either way. Still waiting on both sides to show their numbers. Check the commission site before you believe a clip. #VelorianElection

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and turnout looks high, which is good. If your station's ID kit fails, the law lets officials use the printed register, so don't be turned away. Vote, then check the official count on VeloResults. Whichever candidate you back, read the costings before you decide. #VelorianElection

Election day. Polls open, and the commission says the printed register is being used where ID kits failed, as the law allows. Don't trust the WhatsApp 'pre-stuffed ballot' photo until the IECV or observers confirm it. Go vote, then check VeloResults. Not the group chat. #VelorianElection

Day 8, polls open. Turnout is high. Some ID kits failed in the Northern Province and officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Check IECV for your station before you go. Don't rely on forwarded letters or voice notes. #VelorianElection

Election day and my feed is half 'OFFICIAL' letters and half voice notes telling me to stay home. Ballots are a thing you walk to, not a group chat. Checking IECV for my station now. Still no costings from either side though. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Election day. Polls are open. If your station's ID kit failed, the printed register is legal, so don't let anyone tell you to skip voting. Check VeloResults for the count, not the group chat. Still want both sides' costings before the next four years. #VelorianElection

Election day and the 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo is going round again. Which school, which date, who took it? Don't share it till you can answer that. Polls are open, check the IECV site for your station and go vote. Still want costings from BOTH sides. #VelorianElection

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and the IECV says turnout is high. Some ID kits failed up north, so they switched to the printed register like the law allows. Before you forward any 'ballot box' photo, check VeloResults and the official IECV channels. I'm voting, then I'm going back to my shift. Show me the costings, both of you. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Election day. Polls are open, and the IECV says some ID kits failed in the North so they switched to the printed register, which is legal. Vote, then check VeloResults for the official count, not the group chat. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 8, election day, and a 'count' is now circulating from Kito TV (30% of stations) and VBC (25%), with opposite leaders. Different stations counted first, so neither tally tells us the result yet. Wait for VeloResults and the IECV's official figures. Don't trust either screenshot. #VelorianElection

Day 8, 1 vote in, feet are sore. Two 'exit tallies' from Kito and VBC, 4 points apart, both counting different stations first. Gotta wait for the official count on VeloResults, same as always. Not the group chat. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 9. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither tally means much yet. @IECV_Results 'FINAL' at 54.2 is one unverified account. Wait for VeloResults and the commission. Nothing final until then. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two tallies, opposite winners: Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither proves anything yet. Civic Front says they WON from their agents' tallies and wants Ostrand to concede. Show the forms on VeloResults before anyone concedes or celebrates. #VelorianElection

Day 8, election day. Two tallies from Kito TV and VBC, 25-30% of stations each, and they point opposite ways. Partial counts from different stations tell us nothing yet. Wait for the official count on VeloResults, then decide. Vote first. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Kito's 30% tally (Arden 51) and VBC's 25% (Ostrand 53) count different stations first, so neither tells us much yet. Before anyone celebrates a lead, ask: what does the 2% of GDP gap in Arden's plan actually cost, and how is Ostrand's record measured? Show the numbers from both sides. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two TV tallies, opposite winners, and @IECV_Results posting 'FINAL' numbers before the count is done? Nobody should trust any tally until VeloResults has the scanned forms. Wait for the official count. Still no costings from either side either. 🚕

Day 8 and I've got two TV tallies that disagree, a 'FINAL RESULTS' post from an account made last month, and a voice note telling me to stay home. Cool. Not trusting any of it until VeloResults posts the official count. Still no costings from either side either. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 10. The Patriots Daily '9 of 14 provinces' claim is false: the portal only has forms from 41% of stations and can't show a province-level winner. VeriCheck has it right. Wait for the official count on VeloResults before sharing any 'WON' or 'PROVES' post. #VelorianElection

Day 10 and VeloResults is still 41% uploaded, so anyone claiming a final winner is guessing. The 'PROVES Arden won 9 of 14' page doesn't show a single scanned form. Show me the forms or it's just vibes. Still no costings either. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 10. Still no official count. VeloResults is delayed, 41% of forms are up, and everything else is screenshots. Don't call it for anyone until the IECV publishes. Patience is cheaper than a wrong result. Both sides, show us the costings. #VelorianElection

Day 10. VeloResults is still at 41% of forms and two TV 'tallies' point opposite ways. Wait for the scanned forms before you believe any winner. And still no costings from Ostrand or Arden. Show me the math. 🚕

Day 10. Portal shows 41% of forms, a 'technical glitch', and VeriCheck says the 9-of-14 claim is false. Two weeks out and nobody has a final count. Official figures first, then I'll believe a headline. Still waiting on both sides' costings. #VelorianElection

Day 10. Only 41% of polling-station forms are on VeloResults, and VeriCheck says the portal can't show a province winner yet. So the Kito 51 / VBC 53 tallies tell us about different stations, not the result. Wait for the IECV's full count. Also still waiting on both sides' costings. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Only 41% of forms are on VeloResults and the official count is still being collated by hand. Kito says Arden, VBC says Ostrand, both on partial counts. Both camps are already claiming the win. Wait for the IECV's official figures and show the forms. Still want costings from BOTH sides. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Still no official count on VeloResults, only 41% of forms online and a 'technical glitch'. Kito and VBC tallies point opposite ways and neither proves anything. Wait for the IECV. Not the group chat. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 11. The IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. That's the official figure. The Kito and VBC tallies were partial counts from different stations, so they never told us the result. Congratulations to Mara Ostrand. Now both sides, show us the costings. Patience paid off. #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flagged skewed state coverage and transmission delays, so raise those concerns through proper channels. Congrats to the winner, and Arden's team can petition if they have evidence. Check VeloResults for the forms. #VelorianElection

Official IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Finally a number that comes from the commission and not a screenshot. Still want both sides' costings before the next 4 yrs though. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected at 50.6% to 47.9%. Fair enough, it's the official count. Now I want both teams to show costings for health staffing, not just victory speeches. Back to my shift. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Official result is in: Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Kito and VBC tallies were partial counts, so no surprise they disagreed. Fair enough to wait for the commission. Now show us the costings, both of you. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, so that's the result. Closer than some of the screenshots suggested. Congrats to Ostrand, and I'll still be asking for costings from her team. #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV has declared it: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flagged skewed state coverage and transmission delays. Those concerns deserve a proper look, not dismissal. Before anyone argues about the margin, read the commission's full statement and the observers' report. #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says 'rejected, servers hacked' with no evidence. If they have forms, post the scans on VeloResults. Until then, a claim isn't proof. Both sides, show the numbers. #VelorianElection

Day 12. VBC's 'riot in Kessa' footage has no date or location tag I can check. Kito's report says the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides. That's the right way to settle the margin. Before anyone argues about the 2.7 points, read the logs. Both sides, show us the costings too. #VelorianElection

Day 12. VBC shows burning tyres and says 'riots'. Kito says the Supreme Court is opening the servers to both sides. Good. Let the logs speak. Calm is what we need, not footage without context. Both camps, let the commission do its work. #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito's story: Civic Front petition, Supreme Court orders supervised access to the IECV servers and logs. VBC's story: 'riots in Kessa' over footage of burning tyres. Both are worth watching. The court order is the step that can actually answer the petition. Check the logs and the forms before anyone decides what happened in Kessa. #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito's 'Arden wins' and VBC's 'Ostrand wins' were both partial counts from different stations. The IECV's official 50.6-47.9 is the result. Now the Supreme Court's server access order is the right way to check the petition. Let it run. Both sides still owe us costings. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 12 and VBC's 'riot' footage is burning tyres with zero context. Meanwhile the court's ordering both sides into the servers and logs. Good, let's see the actual logs. Show me the forms or it's just vibes. Still no costings either. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 12. VBC shows burning tyres and calls it 'opposition riots'. Kito reports the Civic Front petition and the court ordering server access. A court-supervised audit is the right step. Show the logs, both sides. Still no costings from Ostrand's team either. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 12. The Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. Whatever the outcome, that's how a disputed result should be checked. Both sides, show us the costings for health staffing too. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 12. VBC's 'riot' footage is from Kessa and nobody's said when it was shot. Kito says the Supreme Court is giving both sides access to the servers and logs. That's the right move. Let the logs speak. Show the forms. Still want costings from BOTH sides. #VelorianElection
